description: Host and port presets for the optional live mailbox connection, with where to create an app password. They prefill the connect form; the Operator can change every value. smtp_security is "ssl" (implicit TLS, usually port 465) or "starttls" (usually port 587). Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 are left out on purpose: they generally require OAuth for IMAP, so their mail is imported from a file. Taken from the providers' help pages as remembered, not checked live: see `verified`.

providers.name: Gmail
providers.app_password: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google Account, then create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. The option is missing for work and school accounts, for accounts protected only by security keys and with Advanced Protection: use file import (Google Takeout) then.

providers.name: GMX
providers.app_password: In the GMX web mail settings, turn on access by POP3 and IMAP. With two-factor authentication on, create an application-specific password in the security settings.

providers.name: WEB.DE
providers.app_password: In the WEB.DE web mail settings, turn on access by POP3 and IMAP. With two-factor authentication on, create an application-specific password in the security settings.

providers.name: Posteo
providers.app_password: Posteo uses the account password for IMAP and SMTP; it has no separate app passwords.

providers.name: mailbox.org
providers.app_password: Use the account password, or, with two-factor authentication on, an application password created in the mailbox.org settings.

providers.name: Fastmail
providers.app_password: Create an app password in Fastmail's settings under Privacy & Security, with access to IMAP and SMTP.

providers.name: iCloud Mail
providers.app_password: Turn on two-factor authentication for the Apple Account, then create an app-specific password at account.apple.com under Sign-In and Security.
